name: BuildAPendant
author: belgiumwebnetinc

sections.description:
Demo | Pro Version bbb

BuildAPendant is a WooCommerce extension that allows jewelry stores to offer customers a complete pendant customization experience. Shoppers can browse diamonds (lab-grown, natural, or colored) and combine them with a wide selection of pendant settings. The plugin intelligently recommends compatible settings based on the chosen diamond shape, carat weight, and other parameters.

Features

  • Real-time integration of natural, lab-grown, and colored diamonds from any marketplace or individual supplier.
  • Define tiered markups for diamonds based on carat and price ranges, with separate markup rates for different suppliers or marketplaces.
  • Manual addition of pendant settings through the WordPress admin panel.
  • Bulk import of pendant settings from multiple suppliers for easier management.
  • Flexible markup rules for pendant settings based on price ranges and suppliers.
  • Bulk diamond import (lab-grown, natural, or colored) via the admin panel.
  • Real-time diamond integration through API, FTP, Google Sheets, or static Excel sheets.
  • Intelligent recommendations – suggest pendant settings that match selected diamonds (by shape, carat, etc.) and vice versa.
  • Advanced search filters for diamonds: shape, carat, color, clarity, and more.
  • Pendant setting filters by style, metal type, color, and compatible shapes.
  • Three-step customization process – start with a diamond or start with a pendant setting.
  • Live preview gallery – customers can view their selected pendant in real-time before checkout.
  • Seamless WooCommerce integration with your shopping cart and checkout.
  • Responsive design for smooth performance across all screen sizes and devices.

sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress dashboard → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Upload the buildapendant.zip file.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Add the shortcode [buildapendant] to any page.
sections.faq:
How do I display the builder on my page?

Use the shortcode [buildapendant] anywhere you want the builder to appear.

Can I customize the look and feel of the design?

Yes, you can customize the styles by editing the CSS file located in the assets/css/ folder.
